name: Texas Data Privacy Act (TDPSA)
statute: Texas HB 4 — Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (effective July 1, 2024)
target_buyer: Texas businesses with any online presence, e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, financial services

icp.company_size: Revenue >$10M OR processing data of 100K+ Texas consumers
icp.geo: Texas — any business targeting Texas consumers or with Texas customers
icp.trigger: Has any online presence serving Texas customers, collects personal data

detection_signals: Privacy policy does not include TDPSA-required disclosures
No opt-out mechanism for sale of personal data
Sensitive data (health, precise location, biometrics) collected without consent
Vendor contracts missing TDPSA-required Data Processing Addendum
enforcement_cases: Texas AG Ken Paxton — aggressive data privacy enforcement history
First AG enforcement under HB 4 anticipated Q1-Q2 2026
